questions.text: Identify and analyze key trends in the historical hourly AQHI dataset (2021-2025). Report interesting patterns.
questions.answer_sentence: AQHI is strongly seasonal (winter polluted, summer clean) with a mid-afternoon peak and early-morning trough; New Territories stations read higher.

questions.text: Choose 1-2 weather variables and report relationships with AQHI; then suggest conditions that maximise Smoking Baby's chance of going outside safely.
questions.answer_sentence: Precipitation and humidity are the strongest weather signals; the safest days are warm, humid, wet summer days with low pressure, early in the morning.

questions.text: Build a simple risk score / formula that incorporates the proposed conditions and test it on the data.
questions.answer_sentence: A standardised logistic model on weather gives validation AUC 0.621; the safest quintile has a 0% poor-day rate vs 0.6% for the riskiest.

row_unit: one row per (timestamp, station) hourly AQHI reading
decision_time: hourly reading; weather joined on the same calendar day (HKT)
entity_risk: Same station under two codes; solved by using a single EPD station name list (18 stations). No alias merges were needed.
graph_reason: The AQHI table is a spatiotemporal panel keyed by (timestamp, station). Stations have fixed identities but there is no edge list or shared real-world graph id in the provided files; a kNN graph on feature columns is disallowed. Time-series and regression are the appropriate tools.
